name: AMB-1 Drift
author: Charles Vestal (AMB-1); Wander, new sounds and new pieces: ashtonwallen
tagline: AMB-1, wandering from piece to piece
description: AMB-1 Drift is AMB-1 with Wander (it glides from piece to piece by itself), new sounds (plucked harp and kalimba, a strings pad, a bowed or glass lead, rain, wind, sea and vinyl, a reverb shimmer) and 24 pieces. AMB-1 turns the M-VAVE FM-1 into a generative ambient machine, inspired by Brian Eno's Music for Airports: breathing voices, soft bells on tape loops of unequal length, a gliding bass and quiet Euclidean percussion, through a tape echo and a plate reverb. You don't perform it, you tend it.
credits: Built on fm1-base and felucca-bsp, from Felucca by Leo Kuroshita (Hügelton Instruments).
